```{=html}
<div class="page-hero">
  <div class="container">
    <h1>Contact</h1>
    <p>Get in touch with the WMIC project team</p>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="container">
  <div class="row">
    <div class="col-md-6">

      <div class="contact-wrapper">
        <p style="color:#607d7d;margin-bottom:2rem;line-height:1.7">
          Whether you have questions about the research, are interested in collaboration,
          or would like to be notified of new publications and updates — feel free to reach out.
        </p>

        <!-- 
          SETUP INSTRUCTIONS:
          1. Go to https://formspree.io and create a free account
          2. Create a new form and copy your form ID (looks like: xpzgkwrb)
          3. Replace YOUR_FORM_ID below with your actual ID
          The free tier allows 50 submissions/month which is plenty for a research website.
        -->
        <form action="https://formspree.io/f/YOUR_FORM_ID" method="POST">

          <div class="mb-3">
            <label for="name">Name</label>
            <input type="text" id="name" name="name" placeholder="Your name" required>
          </div>

          <div class="mb-3">
            <label for="email">Email address</label>
            <input type="email" id="email" name="email" placeholder="your@email.com" required>
          </div>

          <div class="mb-3">
            <label for="subject">Subject</label>
            <input type="text" id="subject" name="subject" placeholder="What is this regarding?">
          </div>

          <div class="mb-4">
            <label for="message">Message</label>
            <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="5" placeholder="Your message..." required></textarea>
          </div>

          <button type="submit" class="btn-submit">Send message →</button>

        </form>
      </div>

    </div>

    <div class="col-md-5 offset-md-1">
      <div style="padding-top:1rem">
        <h3 style="font-family:'DM Serif Display',serif;color:#1a4a4a;font-weight:400;margin-bottom:1.5rem">Direct contact</h3>

        <div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem">
          <div style="font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.07em;color:#3d9e9e;margin-bottom:0.3rem">Email</div>
          <a href="mailto:your.email@university.ac.uk" style="color:#1a4a4a;text-decoration:none">your.email@university.ac.uk</a>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem">
          <div style="font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.07em;color:#3d9e9e;margin-bottom:0.3rem">Institution</div>
          <span style="color:#607d7d">Your Department<br>Your University<br>City, Country</span>
        </div>

        <div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem">
          <div style="font-size:0.8rem;font-weight:500;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.07em;color:#3d9e9e;margin-bottom:0.3rem">Links</div>
          <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000" style="color:#3d9e9e;text-decoration:none;display:block;margin-bottom:0.3rem" target="_blank">ORCID profile</a>
          <a href="https://github.com/A-DePalma" style="color:#3d9e9e;text-decoration:none;display:block" target="_blank">GitHub profile</a>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

  </div>
</div>
```
